messages:
nina: starting thread to finalize pen-test access & evidence flow for the external assessment. scope: staging-cluster + staging-api-gateway. desired window: Tue 09:00-18:00 PT. main open items: KMS handing (prefer non-key-share), RBAC for ephemeral roles, S3 retention/immutability, SIEM access for assessors, and how we track remediation tickets.

alex: re KMS i propose using a KMS Grant rather than creating a new key. we can create a grant that allows Encrypt/Decrypt for the packager principal for a 72h lifetime and then revoke. avoids creating long-lived alias. thoughts?

devon: grants are good. be mindful that grants are per-key and you still need a principal for the grant. we can provision a short-lived packager lambda role that assumes via sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity and the grant targets that role. after packaging we revoke the grant.

nina: nice. how do assessors actually decrypt? we want them to not hold keys.

hannah: assessor flow: packager wraps artifacts with KMS, uploads to readroom S3 with Object Lock in Governance mode for the engagement prefix so objects cant be deleted during the retention window. then we issue presigned GETs tied to a temporary role that has s3:GetObject. packager will also generate a one-time unwrap URL that calls a short-lived unpacker service which uses the grant to decrypt and streams output to assessor UI. assessors never get raw KMS perms.

alex: for S3 retention confirm: Governance mode + retention 90d for the prefix, but allow legal to lift governance in the rare case if needed. also enable S3 server access logs and CloudTrail data events for s3:GetObject on the prefix. export logs to audit-bucket with 1y retention.

devon: RBAC: we should create two roles: pt_assessor_console (read-only console access for logs/traces, no write) and pt_assessor_fetch (s3:GetObject limited to readroom prefix). both roles must include an aws:SourceIp condition with assessor IP ranges and aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true. additionally attach an IAM session policy that restricts CloudWatch Insights query time ranges to the window to prevent expensive queries.

nina: good point about query limits. can we pre-run heavy insights queries and attach the results to the evidence bundle so they don't need to run expensive ones live?

hannah: yes please. precompute heavy slices and include as CSVs. also add a metrics snapshot (Prometheus export) and traces sample. provide links to sanitized raw traces rather than full spans if PII sensitive.

ops: we'll spin up an ephemeral bastion (jump.pt-eng.<region>.redwood) that locks down egress and logs session activity to our session-recording S3. allowlist assessor IPs only for the window and revoke afterwards. we'll also create a temporary VPC endpoint for S3 to keep traffic internal.

nina: incident handling: if assessor triggers an unexpected outage or finds high-sev vuln that can affect production, do we stop the test immediately?

hannah: follow the stop-and-preserve rule. immediate pause, rotate keys, snapshot infra, preserve all evidence. call sec-oncall and the engagement lead will coordinate with legal. for non-critical findings we continue and flag the finding for immediate remediation triage.

sec-oncall-bot: @oncall if the engagement causes service degradation >3 minutes, escalate per our incident policy: https://redwood.internal/oncall/engagement-policy.

nina: remediation tracking: create a jira epic ENG-PT-472 and link all vulnerabilities. triage owners assign P1/P2 labels. we want a fast retest slot in 72-96h after fixes land. please use the vuln-tracker board so partner-facing statuses are hidden until signoff.

alex: will add the Jira epic and create two swimlanes: remediation and verification. also add template PR labels: pt-fix-needed, pt-fixed-needs-review.

devon: log retention note: CloudWatch retention extended to 90d for the log groups in scope. we'll export relevant log groups to S3 as gzipped bundles right after the window end and copy to readroom prefix.

nina: acceptance checklist for handover: 1) KMS grant created & documented, 2) presigned URLs + unpacker ready, 3) S3 prefix with Governance lock + server access logs, 4) ephemeral roles + trust policy + IP allowlist, 5) bastion + session recording, 6) jira epic created, 7) SIEM forward (events & object access) configured.

hannah: I'll own SIEM forwarding (Datadog ingest + Splunk mirror) and the unpacker service. plan to post config snippets here shortly.

ops: I'll update infra playbook and post the bastion ACL and VPC endpoint details.

nina: thanks all. i'll wait for the grant ARN and role ARNs before we hand over credentials. i'll open the retest booking thread once remediation PRs are merged. :thumbsup:
